role: Dimension travel: the Teleporter (placeInPortal, placeInExistingPortal with the destination-coordinate cache, makePortal, removeStalePortalLocations, the End's obsidian platform), Entity's portal timers (setInPortal and onEntityUpdate's portal section), the per-dimension coordinate scaling of transferEntityToWorld, and the End-exit respawn placement.

structs.name: struct portal_cache_entry
structs.java: Teleporter.PortalPosition (ChunkCoordinates plus lastUpdateTime) keyed in destinationCoordinateCache

structs.name: struct portal_cache
structs.java: Teleporter.destinationCoordinateCache (LongHashMap) plus destinationCoordinateKeys (ArrayList, the removal order)

structs.name: struct teleporter
structs.java: Teleporter: worldServerInstance, random, the cache; plus the world time for stale removal

structs.name: struct portal_entity_state
structs.java: Entity.timeUntilPortal, portalCounter, inPortal, teleportDirection, getMaxInPortalTime, getPortalCooldown, dimension

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
lines 67 and 70, function portal_cache_init: calloc and malloc of the cache (at teleporter creation)
line 102, function portal_cache_grow: calloc rehash growth inside the tick when the cache fills
line 162, function portal_cache_put: realloc of the key list inside the tick
lines 109, 117, 147, 183: open-addressing probe while loops bounded only by table load
lines 212-228, function portal_cache_remove_stale: removal order carried by the keys array (mirrors destinationCoordinateKeys), with O(n) shifting per removal
line 296, function teleporter_place_in_existing_portal: while loop descending a portal column, bounded by the column
lines 464 and 529, function teleporter_make_portal: while loops dropping to the ground, bounded by y > 0
lines 492 and 550, function teleporter_make_portal: goto-based early exit from the site scan
line 264, function teleporter_place_in_existing_portal: 128-block radius scan (257x257 columns by height) on a cache miss
notes: Caller: serverreplay.c, which seeds each teleporter's rand from the world seed (Teleporter's new Random(seed)) and clears in_portal itself after a non-triggering tick, as Entity.onEntityUpdate does. Differences seen against oracle/src/entity/Entity.java and not verified against a recording: portal_entity_tick returns before the trailing --timeUntilPortal on the tick it triggers (Java decrements after travelToDimension), and it does not check ridingEntity == null. portal_cooldown defaults to 10 (EntityPlayer's getPortalCooldown); Entity's own is 300. portal_site_draw_order_override (line 446) perturbs makePortal's random start direction for a negative check.
